rule5_findings.fix: Acceptable as a bibliographic mention; do not add detail on what the report says about them.

rule5_findings.problem: Parenthetical descriptors for parts of ISO/IEC 9646 (e.g. abstract test suite specification) approach summarising content; they are part titles.
rule5_findings.fix: Replace with part numbers and exact catalogue titles only.

rule5_findings.problem: Discusses TTCN-3 and ISO/IEC 9646 concepts in general terms.
rule5_findings.fix: Limit to the paper's own abstract; no description of the standards.

missed_items.fact: Several API profiles in aas-test-engines are marked as supported for IDTA members only, which limits what a public engine can wrap.
No commit or release since 2025-08-05, over a year before the retrieval date.

overall: Bibliographic data are highly reliable: all 20 sampled DOIs match Crossref on title, year, venue and first author, and the repo, PyPI, NIST, ETSI and Zenodo facts match. Weaknesses are small: the 'read-only API profiles' wording is wrong, 'maintainer' should be 'owner', Moseley's year and venue are unsettled, and the ISO part list needs care. Full-text claims about Miny 2026 and REECO, and every engine-mapping 'existing_check', were not re-verified here. The file's own honesty flags (metadata_only, secondary_only) are appropriate and rule 5 risk is low.
